name: Enthalpy v0.4.23
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.23

## Fixed

- Sync shows specific messages for upload limits, connection failures,
  timeouts, and service failures.
- Sync support reports keep the failed setup step, progress counts, and service
  error codes. They exclude personal content and credentials.
- Copy support report now uses the native clipboard and is available when
  signed out. If copying fails, the report appears as text for manual copying.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon. Windows Sync enrollment is deferred until its installed-build
  acceptance passes.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
- Linux packages are deferred.
